title: Celestin's wartime band and his later Dixieland turn
summary: In 1941 Celestin, after a shipyard job and a broken leg, formed a band with Ricard Alexis, Albert Walters and others; Giles says Celestin was not originally a Dixieland man.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah, they did, yeah, they played that way back. Really, he was a real great musician. And I played with Silly Stamp Band, made up a band, not our, he made the band up. This was in around, last of 41. He had, things had gotten bad and he had broke up his band. He didn't have any band, Silly Stamp, Papa Silly Stamp.
Yeah, I remember, while he was out.

Yeah, he had broke up his band and took a job in 41, until the war was on, in that time, at the shipyard. And he made up a band, Ricard, a long time ago when he had his tuxedo band, was a trumpet player.
That's right, we talked about Ricard.

And Bill Mathias had played drum with Silly Stamp. He was a drummer a long time ago. When he made up this band, Ricard was playing bass with him. And Bill Mathias, did he playing drum, he was playing trombone with him. Albert Walters was playing trumpet. And Kit Clayton was playing with him. And we must have been up about six months. And I thought, when they knocked off at Higgins Shipyard, there were five and six hundred people would be docking off. And fellas coming through with their cars in a hurry. And they run into several fellas and knock them down, breaking their arms. And Silly Stamp was one of the ones that they run in and broke his leg. Well that broke up the band. After he was down with his leg, we had straight away and went to play with other different fellas. And Silly Stamp was out for maybe a year or so, and some fella said that he wanted to get a Dixieland band to play at the paddock. And he contacted Ricard. So Ricard saw Silly Stamp and instead of making an orchestra like he always had, he started playing Dixieland. So I mean some people think that Silly Stamp always was a Dixieland man, but he played classical music.
Yeah, some of his old records are a larger band. Yeah.

This in the later years, the last band that he got so famous was Dixieland was when he played on Boyfriend Street. Yeah. Because he was not a Dixieland man, but the average people think he was. But in the later years he began to play Dixieland because he never played unless he had two trumpets, a self-made tree, or either one trumpet player. But when he was on Boyfriend Street, he played one trumpet. That's the only time.
